title: Theophysics Typed Canon - Lane 4 First Pass

canonical_node.axiom: Only true primitives become Lean axioms; definitions become definitions; theorems become proof targets; predictions, protocols, and evidence nodes stay outside the proof kernel as metadata or test objects.
definitions: Action: what the system should do
Boundary: what it does not do
derivation: The document classifies nodes into types (primitive, definition, theorem, etc.) and risk levels.
It applies manual cleanups to reclassify certain nodes (e.g., EXP5.1/EXP5.2 as EvidenceNode, PERSONHOOD as OpenProblem).
It states a Lean 4 rule that only primitives become axioms, definitions become definitions, theorems become proof targets, and non-proof items stay outside the kernel.
Therefore, the canonical action is to enforce this typing discipline in Lean 4 preparation.
canonical_node.action: Enforce the typed canon: treat only primitives as axioms, definitions as definitions, theorems as proof targets, and keep predictions, protocols, and evidence nodes as metadata or test objects outside the proof kernel.
boundary: Does not treat every node as an axiom.
Does not upgrade bridge claims or theological identifications into formal derivations without explicit assumptions.
Does not include predictions, protocols, or evidence nodes inside the proof kernel.
test: Check that each node in the Lean file is classified according to the typed canon (primitive, definition, theorem, etc.).
Check that no bridge identification or theological identification is silently used as a formal derivation.
Check that predictions, protocols, and evidence nodes are not placed inside the proof kernel.

dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a typed classification of theophysics nodes for Lean 4 preparation, separating primitives, definitions, theorems, and non-proof items.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the existing canon structure and manual cleanups (e.g., EXP5.1/EXP5.2 as EvidenceNode, PERSONHOOD as OpenProblem).
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: Without this typed canon, Lean 4 preparation would lack a clear rule for which nodes become axioms, definitions, or proof targets, risking misclassification.

classification.recommended_atom_action: Enforce as a protocol for Lean 4 preparation; do not treat as a formal proof.

overstatement_risks: May be mistaken as a formal proof of theophysics claims.
May overstate the completeness of the typed canon.
May imply that the classification is final when it is a first pass.
kill_conditions: If the typed canon is contradicted by the actual Lean file.
If bridge claims are silently used as formal derivations.
If the classification is not reproducible from the source files.

plain_summary: This document is a first-pass typed canon for Lean 4 preparation, classifying nodes into types and risk levels. It establishes a rule that only primitives become axioms, definitions become definitions, theorems become proof targets, and other items stay outside the proof kernel. It is a meta-claim about how to structure the Lean development, not a proof of theophysics itself.
